To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) mechanical stimuli (shear stress or cyclic strain) can influence the differentiation process of MSCs towards SMCs or endothelial cells; 2) the mechanisms by which the mechanical cues influence the differentiation process involve the activation of specific signaling pathways; 3) mechanical stimuli can influence MSC differentiation in synergy with other components of the environment; and 4) mechanical stimuli can maintain MSC differentiation in vitro.
